aspect: IMSS coverage follows the formal contract
description: Social security health coverage attaches to formal employment, so ECO-001's 55% informality rate is also a coverage statistic.
energy_note: Half the country, outside the system by definition.

aspect: The replacement has changed name and design repeatedly
description: Seguro Popular, then INSABI, then IMSS-Bienestar - each transition producing a period in which people were unsure what they were entitled to and where.
energy_note: Three schemes in a decade, and nobody knows which applies.

aspect: Out of pocket at the point of need
description: Catastrophic health spending falls on households directly, which is how a treatable illness becomes a debt or a sold plot of land.

aspect: SCENE - which one is it this year
description: His mother needs the medication monthly. Seguro Popular covered it. Then INSABI. Now it is IMSS-Bienestar and the pharmacy at the clinic says it is not arriving. He buys it privately for 1,400 pesos a month and stops asking which scheme he is in.
energy_note: Three national health schemes, one empty pharmacy shelf.
